name: ninthspace-ralph
description: Fork of Anthropic's ralph-loop plugin: a loop that does not end silently, a hook whose output cannot be mistaken for the model's completion promise, and a working pause

plugins.name: ralph-loop
plugins.description: Interactive self-referential AI loops for iterative development. Claude works on the same task repeatedly, seeing its previous work, until completion. This fork keeps the loop's state file when it cannot read the transcript, never prints the completion promise inside its own tags, and honours `active: false` as a non-destructive pause.
